text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: GPU_POOL_MEM_PRESSURE firing for pool gpu-us-west-2-a. Triggered by 45% of nodes above 90% GPU memory. PD key: PD-112233. Auto-injecting throttle policy. @oncall
maya: acked PD-112233. investigating. grabbing gpunode logs.
liam: oncall, do we have any customer-facing alerts? I'll open a ticket if needed.
sasha: adding myself — if this escalates, escalate to SRE lead. also check KV cache eviction counts.
maya: running `kubectl -n inference get pods -l pool=gpu-usw2-a` -> some pods in CrashLoopBackOff, a few OOMKilled. `nvidia-smi` shows memory at 98% on node gpu-03.
maya: log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T08:12:02Z ERROR cuda: out of memory allocating 1.2G
stack: runtime/gpu/allocator.go:421
```
liam: looks like a kvcache prefetch storm. kvcache evictions spiked. routing tripped to lower-priority customers.
sasha: can we evict kvcache on busiest pods? maya, try setting ENV KV_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES=10000 and restart pods in the pool, one by one.
maya: doing a rolling restart with `kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-worker -n inference --field-selector=spec.nodeName=gpu-03` — starting with gpu-03 to relieve pressure.
pd-bot: PD-112233 acknowledged by maya at 08:13 UTC. Escalation timer paused.
liam: notifying support: "Potential degraded latency for tenant: AcmeCorp (dedicated pool)." opening internal ticket #INC-4589.
maya: temp mitigation: restarted 2 pods on gpu-03, memory dropped to ~65% on those. still ~92% on gpu-05. evictions continuing.
sasha: plan B: enable fallback model variant `redwood/raven-7b-quant-fallback` for routing for AcmeCorp for next 30m. liam, can you flip the route in the console? keep traffic routed to same pool if possible.
liam: flipping route now to fallback variant for the tenant. will monitor error rate and latency. :thumbsup: 
maya: added watch on autoscaler: it's at max replicas; scaling can't add more GPUs in this AZ. requesting cross-AZ failover.
sasha: I'm requesting emergency capacity in us-west-2-b and a pool drain for high-frag nodes. @ops-rotation can you approve cross-AZ failover? pd-bot: set severity=major.
ops-rotation: approved, starting cross-AZ reroute and spinning up instances in us-west-2-b. ETA ~6m.
maya: after starting instances in us-west-2-b, some pods scheduled there. GPU memory on new nodes stable. latency for AcmeCorp dropping close to baseline.
liam: support pinged AcmeCorp with status update and mitigation steps. they're seeing reduced errors.
incident-bot: PD-112233 resolved (auto-resolved) at 08:21 UTC after mitigation. Please confirm final handoff/retrospective.
sasha: will write a short postmortem, marking root cause: aggressive kvcache prefetch combined with quantized model memory footprint which triggered fragmentation/oom on a few nodes. action items: throttling prefetch, add pool headroom, refine alert thresholds. Maya/Liam assign owners.
maya: acknowledged. I'll follow up on prefetch throttle RFC. liam: I'll coordinate capacity playbook updates and customer comms.
maya: handing off to night shift. @ops-rotation taking over at 08:30 UTC. :handshake:
